cues.label: cramped London lodging at night: the soft hum of a gas lamp, a distant street murmur through the window, a clock ticking
pen nib scratching hard along a ruler edge, a bold ink line (scratchy drag), wooden ruler slapped down just before
wooden set square clacks onto the board at 45 degrees, a small snap
pen runs fast along the ruler again, a long dry stroke
thumb pushes a station mark along the board, a soft paper scrape and a tiny tick
soft swooping camera whoosh toward the window, the street murmur swelling (crowd, a bus, a distant bell) as the glass fills the frame
